profile.name: NanoScan压电Z轴定位台
profile.description: NanoScan是一种压电驱动的Z轴纳米定位台或显微镜对焦平台，用于在微米至亚微米尺度上精确调节样品或物镜的轴向位置。它常用于显微成像、自动对焦、Z轴扫描、表面形貌测量及需要快速精密焦点控制的实验。
profile.description_en: The NanoScan is a piezo-driven Z-axis nanopositioning stage or microscope focus stage used to precisely adjust the axial position of a sample or objective over micrometer-scale travel. It is commonly used for microscopy, autofocus, Z-scanning, surface profiling, and other experiments requiring fast and precise focus control.
